name: Republika Srpska
alt: Serb Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Republic of the Serb People of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Serbian Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina

predecessors.name: Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
predecessors.text: the Serb-held regions of the Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina, which the Assembly of the Serb People proclaimed on 9 January 1992 as part of 'Yugoslavia'

successors.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
successors.text: Republika Srpska as drawn at Dayton, 'one of its two main' divisions of the state under Annex 4

ledger.x: 9 January 1992: the Bosnian Serbs proclaim their republic.
6 April 1992: the Bosnian War begins and the Serbs take much of the country.
12 August 1992: the Serb republic takes the name Republika Srpska.
21 November 1995: the Dayton talks end the war.
14 December 1995: the Dayton Agreement is signed in Paris and Republika Srpska becomes an entity of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

wars.name: Bosnian War
wars.outcome: Ended by the Dayton Agreement (initialled 21 November, signed 14 December 1995), which made Republika Srpska one of two entities of Bosnia and Herzegovina; Srebrenica fell in July 1995 and more than 8,000 Bosniak men and boys were killed there.

certainty.note: Front lines, not borders, until the Dayton inter-entity boundary (Annex 2); the pages give no yearly maps.
